notes: Governance-first vendor, named a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Governance Platforms. Three modules (Identify, Protect, Enforce) plus Guardian Agents (Sentinel observes, Operative blocks). Endlayer is a newer on-device product built by Holistic AI (macOS, Windows, Linux) with Sensor, Decoder and Guardian tiers, including a local TLS-terminating gateway. Module 7 and 8 credit is thin: 'Agent Identity' appears only as a label on the platform page, and code scanning serves AI discovery, not security flaws. Searched 'Holistic AI model file scanning malware / training data poisoning / dataset PII scan' with no hit. Credo AI calls Holistic AI a technical risk and red teaming tool.
